payload.blocks: Landing phase 5 of plan 261125-2313 (branch p05b, reviewed), then phases 6 and 7.
payload.headline: Run `fgos git recover` yourself so phase 5 of plan 261125-2313 can land? No unconfined session can run it

parts.cause: Recover has to run outside the cage. In the lead's window it answers ref-invalid, and in mine it answers Read-only file system. lead:SUPERVISOR is registered alive but I can't reach it by message. Recover only settles a chain for the writer that started it, which here is the lead's writer from 09:58, so a run under your own identity may answer 'kept' for that chain.

options.does: In a plain shell, run: cd /home/vantt/projects/forgent && fgos git recover. Then paste its answer (recovered, freed, kept) into the lead or onto this question.
options.gain: Lands for phase 5 can resume, and you see at once whether the chain is kept for its writer.
options.harm: If it answers 'kept', the chain needs a recover under the lead's writer or through the head socket (the next option).
options.label: You run recover in the main checkout

options.cost: One plan of work, plus the wait.
options.does: I file a backlog row so a head can call git recover through its socket under its own writer.
options.gain: Fixes this for every later lead.
options.harm: Phase 5 stays parked until that item lands.
options.label: Open an item: recover through the head socket

parts.recommendation: Run recover yourself first. It is the documented door and it never deletes anything. Open the item only if it answers 'kept'.

scope.allows: Running `fgos git recover` in the main checkout, then the lead retrying the land.
scope.forbids: Hand-made resets, deleting refs, worktrees or locks, or any main-checkout-reset that recover prints without a separate decision.

parts.what: You answered q-bvvdct5edg with 'Run fgos git recover', but nobody has run it yet. The lead's retry of the land (ticket c-23841) was refused at 'prepare: resource-recovery-required'.
